jobs.title: GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
GIS Specialist V

We are seeking a highly experienced GIS Specialist V
to serve as the senior geospatial authority for a major regional program. In this role, you will lead complex spatial analysis, manage enterprise geospatial and non‑geospatial databases, and ensure data products meet strict cartographic and metadata standards. You will guide analytic approaches, oversee data publishing processes, and support the development of tools and applications that make regional data accessible and actionable.
What You'll Do

Perform and direct advanced spatial analysis using all ArcGIS modules, supported by enterprise databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
Utilize Esri server/mobile products, QlikSense, Power BI, open‑source GIS tools, and image processing software including ERDAS and ENVI.
Automate spatial data handling, image processing, and analysis using multidisciplinary datasets from chemistry, hydrology, toxicology, biology, geography, and geology.
Maintain geospatial and non‑geospatial enterprise databases, file geodatabases, and related web services, ensuring compliance with established standards.
Manage regional data holdings and ensure data assets are properly published, documented, and discoverable.
Develop and manage data intake processes for diverse data formats and sources, ensuring alignment with data requirements.
Collaborate with internal and external workgroups to refine data publishing processes and ensure procedural completeness.
Build and maintain data portals that support public and client access to environmental and operational data.
Develop front‑end and back‑end interfaces for applications, integrating modeling results into final products.
Provide visualization, analytics, and informatics support using Qlik, R, Python, Jupyter, and Power BI across cloud and local environments.
Review team work products for compliance with cartographic and metadata standards.
Deliver training on GIS tools, data systems, and data management best practices.
Produce and maintain system architecture documentation as systems evolve.

Education:
BS/BA degree or equivalent.
Experience:
Minimum of 8 years of GIS industry experience.
Technical Skills:

Proficiency with the Esri suite of GIS products.
Working knowledge of SQL for spatial queries.
Familiarity with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience with Python and R scripting.
Communication:
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Suitability:
Must be eligible to obtain and hold a Tier 4 Public Trust.

Experience administering Esri enterprise environments, including ArcGIS Server 10.x and ArcGIS Online.
Qlik Sense or Power BI application development experience.
Familiarity with GeoPlatform‑style data environments, metadata tools, or data gateways.
Experience leading or reviewing the work of GIS staff.

Overview:

The Integrated Operations Support Division (IOSD) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) seeks a Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Specialist to serve as the functional system administrator for ArcGIS Enterprise, and partners with IT staff and data owners across ORNL. The GIS Specialist is the primary point of contact for the enterprise GIS platform, fostering customer relationships by proactively identifying, implementing, and communicating continuous improvement efforts.

The GIS Specialist will build awareness of existing GIS capabilities, develop, and implement new tools and workflows, and support the vision, roadmap, standards, and governance for GIS across the Directorate. Supported functional areas include site, facility, and asset management, utilities distribution, logistics, environmental safety & health, strategic planning, construction, engineering, emergency management, and security.

Major Duties/Responsibilities:

Serve as the functional system administrator for ArcGIS Enterprise (Portal, Server, Data Store) and associated applications and datasets.
Design, develop, and maintain web maps, web applications, web scenes, dashboards, and mobile apps using ArcGIS Experience Builder, Dashboards, Survey123, and related tools.
Administer and optimize enterprise geodatabases, including SQL views, schema design, privileges, versioning, and replica management.
Support data interoperability efforts to integrate CAD, BIM, tabular, and other datasets into enterprise GIS; ensure correct coordinate systems and projections (including ORNL custom coordinates).
Develop and maintain Python scripts, Arcade expressions, attribute rules, and automated processes (including batch scripts and Windows Task Scheduler jobs).
Publish and manage map, feature, image, geoprocessing, and real-time (GeoEvent) services.
Implement and support offline GIS workflows, mobile field work, GPS-based data collection, and road network analysis (Network Analyst).
Maintain data governance, metadata standards, and documentation for Enterprise GIS assets.
Develop and maintain GIS platform documentation including Software Quality Assurance, Business Impact Analysis, Contingency Planning, System Security Plans, etc.
Work closely with managers, process owners, IT staff, and end users to understand requirements, prioritize enhancements, and implement system/process improvements.
Provide general troubleshooting and user support to both GIS technical staff and non-technical map users
Administer licensing and user accounts for desktop and server applications.
Coordinate software procurement, planning, installation and vendor relations and support including training, coordinating software demonstrations, benchmarking, etc.
Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

Basic Qualifications:

A BS/BA degree in GIS, geography, environmental science, environmental informatics, computer science, engineering, natural sciences, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of relevant GIS experience.
Proficient with ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Enterprise; capable of architecting, developing, and maintaining web maps and web applications from enterprise data.
Experience with GIS data analysis, data cleaning/curation, and integration of multiple data formats (including CAD).
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases for GIS workflows.

Preferred Qualifications:

MS/MA degree in geography, GIS, environmental science, environmental informatics, computer science, engineering, natural sciences, or a related field.
Experience as a technical lead, system administrator, or architect for an enterprise GIS environment.
Experience working with facilities and operations organizations, city/county governments, or utilities.
Advanced experience with:
ArcGIS Experience Builder and Dashboards
Enterprise geodatabases (e.g., SQL Server) including versioning and replicas
ArcGIS Server and Portal administration
Network Analyst and road network management
GeoEvent Manager and real-time GIS

Experience integrating GIS with asset management systems (e.g., Octave EAM) or other enterprise business systems.
Experience with Python and/or Arcade for GIS automation, analysis, or business logic.
Background in software support or customer-facing technical roles, including training and documentation.
Ability to work collaboratively with a diverse group of stakeholders and contribute to team goals.
Strong prioritization, communication, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

Special Requirements:

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Under the limited supervision of a supervisory official in a state department, institution, agency, or local government agency, performs complex technical or scientific work including field and office studies, surveys, inspections, or investigations associated with enforcement of environmental laws and/or regulations, and environmental review and control work, or organizes and carries out programs/projects designed to study and evaluate environmental impact of specific projects on the environment; organizes and develops tests and reports to assess environmental impacts on physical, natural, and/or human environments; investigates environmental complaints concerning projects; conducts contract, grant, and/or loan processing; may be required to function as a lead worker providing guidance to lower-level Environmental Specialists; does other related duties as required.

Specific to the Position

​
Positions 1, 2, 3 - Northern Field Operations:

This position will require the timely review of remedial action reports submitted by certified environmental contractors performing remediations of homeowner heating oil tanks and Licensed Site Remediation Professionals submitting remedial phase reports related to Educational Facilities and Child Care Centers . The technical reports are evaluated to determine compliance with soils and groundwater remediation standards. This position will require field inspections of sites including Educational Facilities and Child Care Centers, Remedial Action Permits, Unregulated Heating Oil Tank (UHOT) cases, and other environmental incidents/complaints.

Position 4 - Southern Field Operations:

This position will require the timely review of remedial action reports submitted by certified environmental contractors performing remediaitons of homeowner heating oil tanks. The technical reports are evaluated to determine if contaminated soils and groundwater are remediated to state standards. This position is mainly an office position, but may include field inspections when warranted.

Duties include managing publicly funded projects with other staff and supervisors in the bureau which includes coordinating site specific funding requests and invoice processing, access coordination, contractor oversight, scope of remedial work development, and scheduling. Fieldwork is a major part of the job responsibilities and includes site inspections, oversight of contractor's conducting construction activities. Staff are assigned a state vehicle, a mobile phone, and a laptop since much of the work week is spent in the field.

Positions 9 & 10 - BCM:

These positions requires a timely review of highly complex remedial reports, workplans, and other documents submitted by environmental professionals on behalf of the responsible parties. The technical reports are evaluated to determine if contaminated media such as soils and groundwater are investigated and remediated to state regulations and standards. Those meeting the standards are issued approvals, those that do not meet the state requirements standards are required to revise and continue remediation until the standards are met.

This position has NJEMs and FSE data entry responsibilities

Health and Safety training is required and medical surveillance.

The technical reports are evaluated to determine compliance with soils and groundwater remediation standards. This position will require field inspections of sites including Educational Facilities and Child Care Centers, Remedial Action Permits, Unregulated Heating Oil Tank (UHOT) cases, and other environmental incidents/complaints.

Position 4 - Southern Field Operations:

This position will require the timely review of remedial action reports submitted by certified environmental contractors performing remediaitons of homeowner heating oil tanks. The technical reports are evaluated to determine if contaminated soils and groundwater are remediated to state standards. Additional responsibilities include technical evaluation of environmental data and remedy recommendations, community interaction, and cost recovery support. Fieldwork is a major part of the job responsibilities and includes site inspections, oversight of contractor's conducting construction activities. Staff are assigned a state vehicle, a mobile phone, and a laptop since much of the work week is spent in the field.

Positions 9 & 10 - BCM:

These positions requires a timely review of highly complex remedial reports, workplans, and other documents submitted by environmental professionals on behalf of the responsible parties. The technical reports are evaluated to determine if contaminated media such as soils and groundwater are investigated and remediated to state regulations and standards. Those meeting the standards are issued approvals, those that do not meet the state requirements standards are required to revise and continue remediation until the standards are met.

This position has NJEMs and FSE data entry responsibilities

Position 12 - BEMSA

The critical duties for this position in the Environmental Measurements unit include overseeing and conducting field sampling collecting ground water, surface water, sediment, soil, landfill gas, indoor air measurements through use of various field instruments and coordinating analytical work through contract laboratories. The work involves performing field sampling and overseeing contractors performing field sampling at various hazardous waste sites both commercial and residential. Health and Safety training is required and medical surveillance.

The Senior Environmental Engineer serves as a strategic technical leader responsible for the oversight and execution of environmental compliance, permitting, and sustainability programs.
